ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; approximately 90% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity black pixels with sparse, high-frequency white punctuation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across 90%+ of fluke area; localized high-intensity white clusters (mottling) observed on the medial surface of both lobes and a high-density cluster at the far right distal tip. Numerous small, discrete white circular points (1-5px) are scattered across the central and right regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 40 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; profile exhibits multiple sharp peaks and jagged valleys with varying depths of 5-20 pixels relative to the lobe centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward and upward; the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced vertical flare at the distal extremity compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (3-15px diameter) localized in the medial region of the right lobe and adjacent to the central notch, consistent with scar tissue mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue voids and jagged amputations along the trailing edge boundary; prominent bulbous, high-intensity textured cluster (barnacle colonization) localized on the superior edge of the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white annular (ring) markings located on the interior dark pigmentation of the right lobe near the fluke center.
